Class SimexidKeycloakConfigurationProperties

java.lang.Object
org.simexid.keycloak.SimexidKeycloakConfigurationProperties
@Component @PropertySource("classpath:simexid-keycloak.properties") @ConfigurationProperties(prefix="simexid.security.keycloak") public class SimexidKeycloakConfigurationProperties extends Object
Configuration properties for Simexid Keycloak integration.
